notes.title: DEMO: Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before
notes.content:
[h1][b]LOST ALONE ULTIMATE[/b] is coming![/h1]

Get ready to dive back in as [b]George Tellaselv[/b].
Whether you are entering this adventure for the first time or have already played the Lost Alone trilogy: you are about to discover a [b]new[/b] world of terror.

Lost Alone Ultimate is not a remake of the [b]Lost Alone[/b] trilogy, but a [b]re-made[/b]!

To let you savor the new world that awaits you, the demo is now available: [b]Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before[/b].

You will experience the day leading up to the events of Lost Alone Ultimate, savoring a light appetizer of the terror that awaits you.

[b]Lost Alone Ultmate - The Day Before[/b] is a self-contained demo that offers content that [b]won't be present in the final game[/b].

So: Enjoy a little secret sneak peek into George's life.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341330/Lost_Alone_Ultimate/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/b81b195edb7fd3cab5a22fbdf4ee085a0cdfcade.jpg[/img][/url]

tags.feature: You will experience the day leading up to the events of Lost Alone Ultimate, savoring a light appetizer of the terror that awaits you.

notes.title: Who Knocks
notes.content:
[h2]I am pleased to announce the arrival of:[/h2]
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211640/Who_Knocks/]WHO KNOCKS[/url][/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211640/Who_Knocks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40960555/74ae13e9d66342253293c2433ff89f972ec259a0.gif[/img]
[/url]

Who Knocks is a first person psychological horror game that will make your nightmares come true. You have just moved into a new house and are about to experience the longest night of your life. Welcome the presences that will knock on your door. Solve puzzles, explore the environment and fight your nightmares.

notes.title: LOST ALONE EP.2 - DADDY IS OUT!
notes.content:
Lost Alone Ep.2 - Daddy has arrived!!
Get ready for a new [b]adventure[/b]!

Thanks to all the people who believed in this project, right from the early access!
The game has been completely rebuilt from scratch and will be like playing a [b]NEW GAME[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41755251/6e7ff7df97ade6d48541ccc50aa60ce85f1c9454.png[/img]
[list]
[*] House completely rebuilt from scratch.
[*] New cutscenes.
[*] Added saves.
[*] New rooms.
[*] New jumpscare.
[*] New spirits.
[*] New puzzles.
[*] Improved graphics.
[*] Partial support for controllers.
[*] [b]A NEW GAME IS WAITING FOR YOU![/b]
[/list]

tags.feature: - Added saves.
- New rooms.
- New jumpscare.
- New spirits.
- New puzzles.
- Improved graphics.
- Partial support for controllers.
